mapper.select: select id,chat_no,account_id,receiver_uid,previous_chat_no,expire_time,status from external_chat_no_pool where account_id=#{accountId} order by status,chat_no
select id,chat_no,account_id,receiver_uid,previous_chat_no,expire_time,status from external_chat_no_pool where chat_no=#{chatNo} for update
mapper.delete: delete from external_chat_no_pool where account_id=#{accountId} and chat_no=#{chatNo} and status='0'
mapper.update: update external_chat_no_pool set status='1',receiver_uid=#{receiverUid},previous_chat_no=#{previousChatNo},expire_time=date_add(now(),interval #{dayNum} day) where chat_no=#{chatNo} and status='0'
